not_found.title: This page or item does not exist.
not_found.cause: The address may be mistyped, or the item was removed.
not_found.action: Check the address, or go back to the home page.

unavailable.title: Alice is temporarily unavailable.
unavailable.cause: Alice cannot reach its database, or it is still starting.
unavailable.action: Wait a minute and try again. If this continues, ask your administrator to check the Alice service.

bad_request.title: Alice could not read this request.
bad_request.cause: The request was incomplete or had fields Alice does not know.
bad_request.action: Reload the page and try again. If you use the API, check the request against the API documentation.

body_too_large.title: The request is too large.
body_too_large.cause: Alice accepts at most 1 MiB of data in one request.
body_too_large.action: Send less data at once, or use a smaller file.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong on our side.
unexpected.cause: Alice hit an unexpected problem while handling your request.
unexpected.action: Try again. If it happens again, give your administrator the request ID shown here.

limited.title: Too many requests in a short time.
limited.cause: Alice slows down repeated requests to protect accounts and the service.
limited.action: Wait a moment and try again.

failed.title: Some fields need your attention.
failed.cause: One or more values are missing or not in the expected format.
failed.action: Correct the highlighted fields and try again.

unauthenticated.title: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
unauthenticated.cause: You signed out, stayed inactive for 30 minutes, or reached the 12-hour session limit.

forbidden.title: You do not have permission to do this.
forbidden.cause: Your role does not include this action.
forbidden.action: Ask an administrator if you need access.

stepup_required.title: Please confirm it's you.
stepup_required.cause: This is a sensitive action, so Alice asks for a fresh verification code.
stepup_required.action: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, then try again.

csrf_failed.title: Alice blocked this request for your safety.
csrf_failed.cause: The request did not come from the Alice page, or the page is out of date.
csrf_failed.action: Reload the page and try again.

invalid_credentials.title: Incorrect username or password.
invalid_credentials.cause: The username or password is wrong, or the account is temporarily blocked after too many attempts.
invalid_credentials.action: Check your details and try again. After several failed attempts, wait 15 minutes.

mfa_invalid.title: The verification code is not correct.
mfa_invalid.cause: The code was mistyped, has already been used, or your device clock is wrong.
mfa_invalid.action: Wait for a new code in your authenticator app and enter it, or use a recovery code.

mfa_already_enrolled.title: Your authenticator app is already set up.
mfa_already_enrolled.cause: Two-step verification was already completed for this account.
mfa_already_enrolled.action: Enter a code from your authenticator app. If you lost the device, ask an administrator to reset it.

password_too_short.title: The password is too short.
password_too_short.cause: Passwords must have at least {{min}} characters.
password_too_short.action: Choose a longer password. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

password_too_long.title: The password is too long.
password_too_long.cause: Passwords can have at most {{max}} characters.

password_breached.title: This password is too common.
password_breached.cause: It appears in a list of passwords that attackers try first.
password_breached.action: Choose a different password that you do not use anywhere else.

current_password_invalid.title: Your current password is not correct.
current_password_invalid.cause: Alice checks your current password before changing it.

try_again.title: Alice is busy with this account. Please try again.
try_again.cause: Another sign-in or verification for the same account was still running, so Alice could not check this one in time. Nothing was counted as a failed attempt.
try_again.action: Wait a second and try again.

username_taken.title: This username is already in use.
username_taken.cause: Usernames must be unique; upper and lower case count as the same.

last_admin.title: Alice needs at least one active administrator.
last_admin.cause: This change would leave no enabled local administrator who can sign in.
last_admin.action: Give another person the Administrator role first, then try again.

scope_not_allowed.title: Your role does not allow this token access.
scope_not_allowed.cause: A token can never do more than its owner's role allows.

code_invalid.title: The setup code is not correct.
code_invalid.cause: The code was mistyped or has been replaced by a newer one.
code_invalid.action: Type the code exactly as the installer printed it. Lost it? Ask the server administrator to run: alice setup-token --reset

locked.title: Too many wrong setup codes.
locked.cause: Alice blocks setup from this computer for 15 minutes after 5 wrong codes.
locked.action: Wait 15 minutes, then enter the code again.

session_expired.title: Your setup session ended.
session_expired.cause: The setup page was idle for 60 minutes, or setup was finished elsewhere.
session_expired.action: Enter the setup code again to continue.

enrollment_missing.title: Please fill in the administrator details first.
enrollment_missing.cause: The verification code step needs the administrator form from the previous step.
enrollment_missing.action: Go back one step and submit the administrator form again.

passphrase_too_short.title: The recovery passphrase is too short.
passphrase_too_short.cause: It must have at least {{min}} characters, because it protects all your backups.
passphrase_too_short.action: Choose a longer passphrase, for example four or five unrelated words.

passphrase_mismatch.title: The two passphrases are different.
passphrase_mismatch.cause: The passphrase and its repetition must match exactly.
passphrase_mismatch.action: Type the same passphrase in both fields.

passphrase_already_set.title: The recovery passphrase is already set.
passphrase_already_set.cause: It can be chosen only once during setup.

incomplete.title: Setup is not finished yet.
incomplete.cause: The recovery passphrase has not been chosen.
incomplete.action: Choose a recovery passphrase, then finish setup.

validation.pattern: This value contains characters that are not allowed.
validation.email: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
